The '''Sheyf's Palace''' stood in a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] in [[137 ABY]]. [[Zharia Vos]], the ruling [[Sheyf]] of the [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] people, resided there. She let the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Azlyn Rae]] stay as a guest before Rae was retrieved by [[Ganner Krieg]] and brought to their home on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].
